summary: L-4 cab on Salmon Butte, Clackamas County, OR, built 1932 on Mount Hood NF; abandoned 1942 or closed 1964; gone by 1966. No current site description found.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com say the cab was abandoned in 1942; the Oregon lookouts page says it was deactivated in 1964 and destroyed in 1966. All three put the end no later than 1966. Story gives both dates.

notes_for_editor: Three pages read; no staffing, fire or access record found, so none written. Access and visit keys omitted. The brief lists kind ground; none of the sources read says whether a tower stood, so the story calls it a cab only. The brief elevation of 1486.5 m matches firelookout.com's 4877 ft. The register credits a National Archives Pacific Northwest Region panorama dated 10-24-33; no image URL collected, so no photo entry. The 1922 item is only seen as quoted on the Oregon lookouts page.
